def bez(p,n=32):

 if typ=='poly':return p
 if typ=='arch':return np.vstack([bez(p[:4]),bez(p[3:7]),p[7:]])
 if typ=='oval':return np.vstack([bez(p[i:i+4]) for i in range(0,12,3)])
 if typ=='u':return np.vstack([p[:3],bez(p[2:6]),bez(p[5:9]),p[9:]])

# Letter strokes recovered from the exemplar as broad-nib Bezier pen passes.
def write_stroke(st,name,practice=False,speed=.002):
    from fit_paths import points
    # Densify the parametric curve, then sample at constant arc length.
    path=points(st)
    seg=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1);dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(seg)]
